Our top recommendation depends on what material you plan to use, as C-Core technology is specially engineered for specific setups:
• For Concentrates: The Booster Extract Vaporizer uses our Onyx Atomizer with an Azul ceramic core to deliver smooth, heavy metal-free vapor with great flavor, and it even connects to any 14mm water pipe.
• For 510 Carts & Concentrates: The Duplex 2 offers 3-in-1 versatility, allowing you to vape 510 oil cartridges, load dabs into a bucket, or use the XL nectar tip directly in your wax jar.
• For Dry Herb: The Brink features a 0.5g Nano-Glazed ceramic chamber that uses 3 types of heat (conduction, convection, and far-infrared) to evenly heat your flower all the way through without burning the edges.
